svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Investigation INV-2041 with a pinned 3D evidence scene
svg.desc: Investigation INV-2041 for INC-2041 Checkout degraded, mitigated at 12:24:40 and recovering. Six people are present. A pinned 3D evidence scene shows the incident floors view frozen at 12:22:00: the application floor as glass over the prod-eu-1 infrastructure floor, the causal path checkout → payments → ⊕ psp-api lit, and the runs-on thread to node ip-10-4-3-12. Seven evidence markers E1–E7 stand in 3D on the entities they cite: E1 the ⚙ 12:19 config change on payments, E2 on the payments → psp-api edge, E3 on the psp-api client pods, E4 on the payments pods, E5 on psp-api, and the refuting E6 on checkout and E7 on pg-orders. A translucent violet camera frustum shows where @priya is looking, with a follow-camera control. Around the scene: a timeline of 15 events on the left, the evidence ledger and the hypothesis tree (H1 the timeout config change ✔, H2–H4 rejected and kept) in the centre, and the AI dock on the right streaming an answer where every claim cites an E-item.
